meta.title: Catch And Tame pets data

sources.label: Catch And Tame! Wiki - Pet category

meta.notes: The standalone Catch and Tame wiki provides an 84-row structured pets table with rarity, biome, BPS, breed-only status, mount status, and notes. Fandom category coverage is broader and includes historical or event pages, so this dataset uses the current structured standalone table as the publishable row source.
